forecast-period.text: A cold front moves across the southeast of the state throughout today and early Monday. Another high pressure system moves into the Bight, behind the front, and moves slowly east throughout the week.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Morning frost for parts of the central and eastern districts, extending north into parts of the Pastoral districts. Isolated showers developing about the Lower Eyre Peninsula during the morning and extending southeast across the Southern Agricultural Area from the afternoon. Maximum temperatures near to below average. West to northwesterly winds ahead of a west to southwesterly change extending across southeastern parts throughout the day. Winds shifting south to southeasterly winds in the north and west during the afternoon.

Patchy morning frost and fog about parts of the Northern Agricultural Area and southern Pastoral districts. Isolated showers about the southeast, clearing during the evening. Maximum temperatures near to below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending north to northeasterly in the west later.

Possible patchy morning frost about parts of the Eyre Peninsula, and parts of the Pastoral districts. Possible morning fog about the Mid North and Flinders districts. Mostly dry. Maximum temperatures near to below average, tending above average in the west. Northeast to southeasterly winds, tending southwesterly in the southeast until the afternoon.

text.p: Possible patchy morning fog about parts of the southeast and frost about parts of the central and eastern districts. Mostly dry. Maximum temperatures near average. Northeast to easterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Wednesday: Less than 2 mm about the Agricultural Areas. Isolated falls between 5 to 10 mm possible about windward facing coasts and ranges and in the South East.
